title: 23 October 2014: Ringo Starr live at Ruth Eckerd Hall, Clearwater, Florida
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall in Clearwater, Florida, USA, on 23 October 2014.

#peacerocks Visa love from Clearwater Florida The last gig on this run Love peace and love ????? pic.twitter.com/x8xKguiyA3

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 23, 2014

What a great last night everything atClearwater Ruthe Eckardt hall thank you everyone for an incredible night he said love ?????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 24, 2014

It was the final show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 46 dates between June and October 2014.

The best gig peace and love The best band peace and love R????????????? pic.twitter.com/4Du0Qgt6Id

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 24, 2014

Starr had previously performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall on 18 May 1997, 7 July 2006, 2 July 2008, 13 July 2010 and 1 July 2012. He returned there on 10 November 2017 and 16 September 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
